en.headline: Mpox cases rise sharply; CHP urges high-risk groups to stay alert
en.dek: A new confirmed case involves a 36-year-old man in stable condition. Hong Kong has recorded 28 Mpox cases this year, 19 of them since August, mostly linked to high-risk sexual contact.
body: The Centre for Health Protection is investigating a new confirmed Mpox case involving a 36-year-old man who developed fever and skin ulcers near the anus on 15 September. He sought care at a social hygiene clinic last Friday and was admitted to Princess Margaret Hospital for isolation. Laboratory tests confirmed Mpox virus; he is in stable condition.

The centre said the patient had high-risk sexual contact with other men in Hong Kong during the incubation period. It is continuing epidemiological investigation and will notify the World Health Organization. Since 2022 Hong Kong has recorded 112 Mpox cases, all male. This year the total stands at 28, including 22 local and six imported cases, of which 19 emerged since August.

Most recent patients reported high-risk sexual behaviour and had not been vaccinated; about 40 per cent were living with HIV. Genetic analysis showed identical sequences in some cases, suggesting shared sources and multiple transmission chains among men who have sex with men. The centre strongly urged people with high-risk contact to take precautions, including vaccination, and to keep contact details of partners to aid tracing.

zh.headline: 猴痘個案近期大幅上升 當局籲高風險接觸者提高警覺
zh.dek: 新增一宗36歲男子確診個案，情況穩定。本港今年累計28宗，當中19宗為8月以來新增，患者多曾進行高風險性行為。
body: 衞生防護中心正調查一宗新增猴痘確診個案，涉及一名36歲男子。他於本月15日出現發燒及肛門附近皮膚潰瘍，上周五到社會衞生科診所求醫，其後入住瑪嘉烈醫院接受隔離治療。臨床樣本經化驗證實對猴痘病毒呈陽性，病人目前情況穩定。
中心表示，患者潛伏期內曾於香港與其他男子有高風險性接觸，正繼續流行病學調查，並會向世界衞生組織通報。自2022年起本港累計錄得112宗猴痘個案，全部為男性。今年至今累計28宗，包括22宗本地及六宗輸入個案，當中19宗為8月以來新增。
近期個案患者均報稱曾進行高風險性行為，大部分未曾接種猴痘疫苗，約四成是愛滋病病毒感染者。基因分析顯示部分個案序列相同，相信存在共同感染源頭及不同傳播鏈。中心強烈呼籲有高風險接觸人士提高警覺、接種疫苗，並保留性伴侶聯絡方法以便追蹤。
